title: Azure OpenAI vs Cognitive Services
description: Choose between Azure OpenAI Service and Cognitive Services for AI capabilities.

data.text: You need to add AI capabilities to your application: text summarization, sentiment analysis, and a chatbot. Should you use Azure OpenAI Service, Cognitive Services, or both?

Use **Azure OpenAI Service** for generative AI (chatbots, summarization, content generation). Use **Cognitive Services** for pre-built AI (sentiment analysis, OCR, speech). They complement each other.
